captions: At Spokewell, a customer types 24.90 into the price box of the booking form.
The old JavaScript gets text instead of a number and just hopes it works.
You give three helpers types that name every case, in three tasks.
Now the price is read either way and comes out in cents, or not at all.
Same form, no guessing. The compiler catches the case you forgot.
